validated_properties: The concrete writer checks the complete current file bytes against expected_before before append; exact prior-frame bytes are the only idempotent retry exception.
An exact uncertain-ack retry fsyncs and readbacks the already-present expected frame instead of appending a duplicate.
No crash-injected call returned a LaunchCapability. A later retry issued one only after a successful fsync/readback path.
A nonempty torn frame fails the writer CAS and requires external recovery to the independently verified valid journal prefix before retry.
For first creation, file fsync is followed by parent-directory fsync before the acknowledgement is returned.
scope: Crash injection was executed on a local POSIX-like filesystem in-process; it tests API/control-flow behavior around uncertain acknowledgement, not the physical persistence probability of a real power-loss/storage-controller failure.

The launch gate was exercised with the same deterministic injected adapter substrate as its prior contract validation because exact production repository siblings were not locally mountable in this runtime.

The writer is single-process/single-writer and whole-file CAS. It does not provide cross-process file locking, distributed consensus, or protection against a storage device that falsely acknowledges fsync.

Torn-tail repair is intentionally not performed by the writer because the writer cannot independently determine the scientific valid-prefix boundary; repair remains the framed journal recovery layer's responsibility.
frontier: Run this concrete writer plus the persisted launch gate against the exact production durable adapter/V3/K-guard sibling files in one repository-local runtime.
Add cross-process writer fencing or an explicit single-writer lease if the actual launcher can have multiple OS processes; current whole-file CAS alone is not a mutual-exclusion primitive.
Wire launch execution so score generation itself receives/validates the LaunchCapability before starting, not only SLOT persistence afterward.
Crash-inject CLOSE fsync/readback plus report-exposure acknowledgement under the same concrete writer and production reporting snapshot implementation.
